enrichment.name: Metro Avenue
enrichment.config_mix: residential plots (20 plots; individual sizes not published)
enrichment.density_note: micro-layout, only 20 plots on 1.37 acres (5,563 sqm)
enrichment.notes: NO PRICING FOUND anywhere - not listed on 99acres, squareyards, commonfloor, nobroker or any developer site; only the TNRERA filing exists publicly. RERA record: promoter is 'ARIHANT FOUNDATIONS REP BY D.MANEESH' (registered as a firm, likely NOT the well-known Arihant Foundations & Housing Ltd, whose site and portal listings show no Ponneri plotted project), site at Vadakarai village, Ponneri taluk, Tiruvallur (pin 600060), declared project cost Rs 9.13 crore, status Completed / stage 'ready to move'. Gross land works out to ~2,995 sqft per plot before roads and OSR.

enrichment.name: Casagrand Estia
enrichment.density_note: boutique low-rise, 173 units on 2.49 acres, single B+G+5 block, 66% open space
enrichment.notes: RERA number matches exactly; site is Vengambakkam village, Tambaram taluk, Chengalpattu district (marketed as 'East Tambaram', not Chengalpattu town) - promoter Casagrand Astute Pvt Ltd, declared cost Rs 100.5 cr. Roman-themed low-rise with 43 amenities, 5,600 sqft clubhouse and 3,060 sqft pool; developer quotes Phase 1 at Rs 4,399/sqft and Phase 2 at Rs 4,499/sqft as early-bird against a claimed Rs 5,500/sqft market rate, so the ticket band is launch pricing.

enrichment.name: Luxe By Dac
enrichment.density_note: boutique, 58 units in a single block on ~0.6 acre (2,424 sqm)
enrichment.notes: RERA number confirmed identical on findbhk and the TNRERA filing, so 'DAC Luxe / Luxe by DAC' on Mudichur Road, Perungalathur (pin 600128) is the same project; promoter DAC Developers Pvt Ltd as GPA holder, declared cost Rs 27.44 cr. TIMELINE CONFLICT: portals advertise Sep-2027 handover but the TNRERA record carries expected completion 2030-01-31 - the RERA date is used here. Kohler/Grohe fittings, two fitness zones, rooftop party deck, 600-800W power backup per unit.

enrichment.name: Mg Avenue
enrichment.density_note: mid-size layout, 133 plots on 4.9 acres (19,850 sqm)
enrichment.notes: DEVELOPER ATTRIBUTION IS WRONG IN THE TRACKER: the TNRERA promoter for TNRERA/2/LO/3965/2025 is MAHENDRA KUMAR GUPTA (a firm), not DRA Homes - DRA's own site lists no Ponneri or Far North project at all. RERA site is Madura Kummangalam village (Ponneri-II), Ponneri taluk, Tiruvallur, pin 601204, DTCP-approved, declared cost Rs 8.61 cr, status Completed / 'ready to move'. Pricing is from a marketing listing for 'MG Avenue at Kummangalam, Ponneri' handled by SGS Properties (Rs 2,100/sqft, plots from 450 sqft, gated with compound wall, concrete roads, street lights, CCTV) - the village and taluk match exactly but the marketer is not the RERA promoter, so treat the price as indicative.

enrichment.name: Godrej OMR plotted development (working name, Siruseri–Kelambakkam corridor)
enrichment.density_note: township-scale plotted development, ~1.2 million sqft of developable potential
enrichment.notes: NO PRICING EXISTS YET - land was acquired outright on 30 June 2026 and no plot sizes, rates or launch date have been disclosed; only scale figures are public. Godrej states ~1.2 mn sqft developable potential and Rs 500 cr estimated revenue potential; dividing those gives roughly Rs 4,170/sqft but that is a revenue-potential derivation, not a quoted price, so it is deliberately left out of the price fields. Site is off OMR on the Siruseri-Kelambakkam belt with direct access to SIPCOT, Vandalur, Guduvanchery and Mahabalipuram.

enrichment.name: Kg Kingdom Of Prosperity
enrichment.density_note: mid-size layout, 239 plots on 9.73 acres (39,400 sqm)
enrichment.notes: RERA number matches exactly; promoter KG Foundations Pvt Ltd, declared cost Rs 34.89 cr, RERA stage 'launch', expected completion 2028-01-30. LOCATION NUANCE: the RERA record places the site in Valarpuram village, Sriperumbudur taluk, Kancheepuram (pin 602105) while marketing calls it Thandalam on NH4 - same belt. Flat Rs 2,499/sqft across sizes and the ticket band checks out arithmetically (614x2499=15.3L, 2387x2499=59.7L). 30 amenities including cricket nets, futsal and basketball courts, amphitheatre and outdoor gym; pitch leans on the Chennai-Bengaluru Expressway and proposed Parandur airport, and plots can be clubbed.

enrichment.name: Rajparis Aeroville
enrichment.density_note: compact gated layout, 87 plots on 3.73 acres across two RERA registrations
enrichment.notes: RERA number confirmed; promoter Rajparis Civil Constructions, site at Cowl Bazar village, Pozhichalur/Polichalur, Chengalpattu (pin 600074) - so it is the Pallavaram/airport side, not Chengalpattu town. SPLIT REGISTRATION: TNRERA/35/LO/0102/2026 alone covers 55 plots on 9,308 sqm (2.30 acres) with declared cost Rs 9.84 cr; the marketed 87 plots / 3.73 acres reported here spans this plus a second registration TNRERA/35/LO/0432/2026. Portals disagree on the entry point (nobroker Rs 49.35L from 641 sqft, roofandfloor Rs 72.36L from 965 sqft, houssed Rs 54.83L) - the 641 sqft figure is used since it reconciles with Rs 7,499/sqft. Wide blacktop roads, full compound wall, solar street lights, storm-water drains, vastu-compliant; near Pallavaram station, MEPZ and the airport.

enrichment.name: Sobha Velachery
enrichment.notes: NO VERIFIABLE DATA - deliberately returning nulls. Sobha's own site lists only ONE Chennai project, Sobha Arbor at Senneerkuppam; there is no Velachery project on it, no TNRERA number, and no credible news of a Sobha land acquisition in Velachery. Every hit is an unaffiliated affiliate/lead-gen microsite (sobhanewlaunch.com, sobhagroups.com, sobhaupcoming.com, sobhabuilder.com, sobhavelacherychennai.com) and they contradict each other flatly: one says 3/4/5 BHK at Rs 70L-2.5Cr, another says 1/2/2.5/3 BHK of 599-1869 sqft at Rs 44.5L-1.97Cr, and the '11.32 acres, 548 units, 11 towers of 3 floors' spec is implausible for Velachery and appears lifted from another Sobha project. None of these figures should be entered into the tracker.

enrichment.name: Vgn Grandeur Phase - Ii - Extension
enrichment.config_mix: residential plots (7 plots; parent layout sells 581-3061 sqft)
enrichment.density_note: tiny 7-plot extension parcel appended to the ~28-acre VGN Grandeur layout
enrichment.notes: RERA number confirmed: promoter VGN Enterprises Pvt Ltd, Koluthuvancherry village, Kunrathur taluk, Kancheepuram (pin 600116 = the Iyyappanthangal belt), just 7 plots on 776.36 sqm (0.19 acres), declared cost Rs 1.65 cr, status Completed / 'ready to move'. PRICING IS INFERRED, NOT QUOTED: no price sheet exists for this 7-plot extension, so the rate band is the parent VGN Grandeur project's quoted Rs 9,000-9,499/sqft at the same location, and the ticket range is that rate applied to the ~1,194 sqft average gross plot implied by 776.36 sqm / 7 plots. Parent layout (500-563 plots, 27.86-29 acres, plots 581-3061 sqft, Rs 1.42-2.08 Cr) offers 4 parks, clubhouse, gym, amphitheatre, temple, blacktop roads with LED lighting, underground EB/sewage and piped gas provision.
